operation_trace.action: Apply preallocated six-slot plan; parse only the literal packet and its selected received summary, retaining the parsed capsule object.
operation_trace.result: Observed packet has one allowed direct dependency and a received capsule with twelve nominations in four pools. No upstream source bytes were exposed.

operation_trace.action: Bind unchanged service, timing, identities, capacity and exclusion rules before selecting a reconstruction.
operation_trace.result: Hard requirement remains 4 at ticks 3-6 and all retainers gone by boundary 10; b=2 unchanged. Q capacity remains unknown; no mixed retainer or outside-resource opening.

operation_trace.action: Select the received conventional clip schedule and copy its exact two primitive actions as the sole builder candidate.
operation_trace.result: Recovered PRE-SVC-C schedule install C at 2, remove C at 7. This is received construction recovery, not new mechanism generation.

operation_trace.action: Reconstruct causal boundaries, operator burden and a separating dependency probe without another candidate schedule.
operation_trace.result: Modeled 0 before 3, 4 at 3-7, no installed retainer at 8; two actions, no impacts, H intact. Installed V alone lacks its required S, so the clip contribution is not interchangeable with empty-sleeve installation. Root replay pending.

operation_trace.action: Audit literal source/candidate graph, mechanism-family counts, exact routed schedule overlap and qualified usefulness.
operation_trace.result: Observed received nominations group into four families with counts 1/3/4/4. Route0 and route1 share all three exact schedules and add no mechanism. AI/AM appear only through forwarded provenance; independent source exposure is not claimed.

operation_trace.action: Transmit unchanged complete parsed capsule within the existing summary string, alongside builder construction, audit and nonempty limits.
operation_trace.result: Prospective transmission retains all twelve nominations and source selectors/hashes/routes/limits. Matched efficacy and compute, originality and empirical independence remain unsupported; earlier outputs and grades remain untouched.

candidates.mechanism: Received clip fastening reconstructed without changing its primitives: install(C) at tick 2 completes at boundary 3 and adds the stipulated 4 retention units; remove(C) at tick 7 completes at boundary 8 and clears the only installed retainer. H stays assembled, with M and S inside it. Retention does not require holding-period work.
candidates.burden: Two operator actions, zero impacts. C is occupied from boundary 3 until boundary 8 and cannot retain elsewhere simultaneously. H remains available. The supplied sleeve and loop schedules each cost six actions including optional restoration and make H unavailable; the conventional two-pin schedule costs four actions and two impacts.
candidates.prediction: Modeled deduction awaiting root replay: capacity is 0 before boundary 3, 4 at required ticks 3,4,5,6 and through boundary 7, then 0 at boundary 8. All installed retainers are removed at 8, allowing separation before boundary 10. This is the conventional J10 clip mechanism, not a newly generated mechanism or physical observation.
candidates.defeat: Separating probe: boundary 2 must lack retention, boundary 3 must show exactly the J05 clip contribution of 4, and boundary 8 must have no installed retainer. A claimed 4 from merely installed V would conflict with J06, which additionally requires detached/free S insertion; clip needs no H detachment. Completing clip installation after boundary 3, clearing it during ticks 3-6, or leaving C installed at boundary 10 defeats the unchanged service contract. No alternative schedule is proposed by these counterfactual probes.
candidates.lineage: Reconstruction from the selected summary of COV-PROVENANCE-DISTINCT-exchange, whose capsule preserves PRE-SVC-C and unchanged route0-C/route1-C descendants. Its exact two-action schedule is copied from the received capsule. The source job names describe forwarded lineage only; the sole direct input is the exchange. No upstream file or independent AM/AI source bytes were read.

attack.failure: Counting twelve names or two route roles as twelve independent mechanisms mistakes lexical/author diversity for causal diversity. The two routed pools each recover identical C/SV/ML schedules. A second failure is to infer completed release from retention cessation: withdrawing S leaves V and unrouting L leaves M. Expanded provenance or differing source exposure cannot establish routing efficacy.
attack.invariant: At least 4 units at every tick 3,4,5,6 followed by separation with all installed retainers removed by boundary 10; one action per tick completing next boundary, exclusive resources, no damage/discard/substitution/outside resource and no mixing pins with a non-pin assembly.
attack.permitted_variable: Choose among existing stipulated mechanisms and audit actual source routes while keeping all hard facts and b=2 fixed. This builder selects conventional C for its two-action burden; no additional mechanism, source bank, ladder opening or source-union equivalence is asserted.
